messages.content: Billing ledger spec: every credit transaction has ledger_id ULID, user_id, delta_credits, balance_after, source enum [recharge, consume, refund, adjustment]. Invariant: balance_after >= 0. Idempotency key required for recharge and refund. Reconciliation job runs every 6 hours; mismatch threshold is 1 cent or 10 credits. Archive ledger rows after 7 years.
Ledger spec includes ULID ledger_id, user_id, delta, balance_after nonnegative, source enum, idempotency for recharge/refund, reconciliation 6h, thresholds, archive 7y.
